newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos better, to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos better, to hold news conference.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos is recovering well from an operation to remove a blockage in his carotid artery and plans to hold a news conference later on Tuesday, presidential palace officials said.

Ramos, 68, underwent surgery on Monday for what officials said could have been a life-threatening affliction. The carotids are two main arteries carrying blood to the brain and a blockage in any one of them can lead to a stroke, they said.

Palace officials said Ramos was in good condition and would meet some reporters in his hospital room later in the day. They did not give any more details about his health and doctors were not immediately available for comment.
